'''K26 Explosive Antivehicle Rockets''' were manufactured by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]], for use in [[wrist rocket launcher]]s such as the [[Kelvarek Consolidated Arms/Legends|Kelvarek Consolidated Arms]] [[MM9 mini concussion rocket launcher/Legends|MM9 rocket system]].<ref name="Arms & Equipment" /> It was capable of reaching a target within 150 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] with an optimal range of seventy five meters,<ref name="Guide to Weapons" /> and had a blast radius of two meters. Costing 500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] each,<ref name="Arms & Equipment" /> the [[Wrist rocket/Legends|wrist rockets]] were capable of destroying a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]]. The Anti-vehicle rocket was a preferred choice of the [[Bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett]], who carried the them during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Guide to Weapons" />

==Behind the scenes==
The K26 Explosive Antivehicle Rocket was first mentioned as simply "K26 explosive rockets" in ''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]'', written by [[Bill Smith]] and released in [[1997]] as the third book in the [[Star Wars: Essential Guides]].<ref name="Guide to Weapons" /> They were identified as "K26 Anti-Vehicle Rockets" in the ''[[Star Wars: Boba Fett]]'' magazine<ref name="Boba Fett">{{StoryCite|story=Boba Fett's Armor: An Essential Guide to a Walking Weapon|book=Star Wars: Boba Fett}} {{1stID|K26 Anti-Vehicle Rocket}}</ref> published in [[April]] [[1998]].<ref name="Cargo Bay">[[Star Wars Galaxy Collector 1|''Star Wars Galaxy Collector'' 1]]</ref> The [[2002]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]'' written by 
[[Jeff Grubb]] and [[Owen K.C. Stephens]] identified the rockets as "K26 Explosive Antivehicle Rockets."<ref name="Arms & Equipment" />
